owner_request: просто создай несколько коротких семплов на 15-20 секунд, я тогда укажу направление
scope: Four20second audition excerpts; retain longer originals; no production expansion or integration.

requests.name: TASK-006 A — Piano Loss — short timbre direction
requests.prompt: A short instrumental sample for a death screen in a bleak hospital survival-horror game. Quiet loss, regret and a life cut short, still unsettling and claustrophobic. Sparse repeated minor/modal melody, low dark register, long gaps, restrained dynamics, no climax or comforting resolution. Make the musical identity audible immediately within the first twenty seconds. Lead instrument: a real acoustic upright piano, slightly muted by soft felt, with clearly audible struck strings and natural wooden resonance. Slow isolated notes, a small descending third, a suspended half-step, and a lower unanswered phrase. A very soft bowed double-bass note may support the piano. Intimate empty-room acoustics, raw restrained early horror-game soundtrack character. The sadness is understated, not a sentimental romantic piano ballad. Acoustic instrument timbres only. No synthesizer, electronic lead, organ, pads, arpeggio sequencer, drums, voices, strings orchestra, guitar or cinematic swell.
